newsitem.title: USA: Cargill Q1 net below last year, up from estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cargill Q1 net below last year, up from estimates.

text.p: Cargill Inc said Thursday that earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter totaled $179 million, which were below last year's record earnings for the comparable period but above the company's initial projections for the quarter.
"Given the difficult business environment facing our industry, this represents solid performance for the quarter," said Robert Lumpkins, vice chairman of Cargill, in a statement.
In its fiscal first quarter ended August 30, 1995, the agribusiness company reported earnings of $226 million, a company spokesman said.
He declined to provide the company's earnings projections for its fiscal 1997 first quarter.

"Our grain processing businesses still face some margin pressures because of historically tight stocks and volatile prices," Lumpkins said. "But good harvests around the world have begun the process of replenishing stocks of grains and oilseeds from the extremely low levels we've seen recently.
"Like grain farmers, we now hope to see global demand for grains and oilseeds strengthen," he said.
